First, we take $\log_3$ of both sides of the equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}
3^{x-2}&=6\\
\log_3\left(3^{x-2}\right)&=\log_3(6).
\end{aligned}
$$

Using $\log_b(b^c)=c$ gives $x-2=\log_3(6)$. Adding $2$ to both sides, we obtain

$$
x=\log_3(6)+2.
$$

We take $\log_5$ of both sides of the equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}
5^x&=15\\
\log_5\left(5^x\right)&=\log_5(15).
\end{aligned}
$$

Using $\log_b(b^c)=c$, we obtain the exact solution

$$
x=\log_5(15).
$$
